remarks: True pride of ownership in this impeccable 1940 stone & shingle English colonial retaining all of the vintage charm/character, & polished to perfection w/top of the line appointments for today's modern lifestyle. Sought after location, set high at the peak of Buckingham Place, w/picturesque setting offering level manicured yard, stone wall, picket fencing, prof. lighting, irrigation controlled by phone, & mature perimeter trees for privacy. The ivy covered stone entry leads to a charming foyer w/coatroom vestibule & powder room. The surprisingly expansive & open floor plan features gleaming hardwood, crown moldings & custom millwork throughout. The generous great room features a wall of built-in book shelves, stone fireplace w/custom wood mantel & surround, plus open to the inviting DR for ease of entertaining. French doors lead to a private office, ideal for work at home. The heart of this special home is the jaw dropping 31.5' chef's kitchen w/double islands, ample custom cabinetry for storage, newer S/S appliances, striking copper accents, & sunny dining area. A convenient mudroom leads to the covered side entrance, 2 car windowed garage, plus the finished lower level rec room & laundry. Total 2,884 sf on 3 finished levels w/4 BRs, 2.5 baths, plus walk up attic for additional storage. The primary suite & one additional bedroom both offer balcony access. New roof & gutter system, new windows, new garage doors, extra spray foam insulation & so much more in this beloved home!
